reflections.title: How Hardship Advances the Gospel

reflect.text: When difficult seasons arrive, we often worry that God's work has been paused. The apostle Paul was locked in prison, unable to travel or visit the churches he loved. Yet he explained that his painful situation actually helped spread the good news about Jesus. Being locked up gave Paul a direct chance to share Christ with the imperial guards who watched him every day.

God frequently works through lowly and unexpected moments to show His glory. When we feel helpless or stuck, divine strength shines brightest against the background of our human weakness. God makes sure that His power is seen clearly, so that all praise goes to Him.

Knowing that God uses trials for good changes how we see our problems. Hard times can even bring us joy because they give us new ways to point others to the Savior. When we face limits or suffering, we can trust that God is actively working through our weakness to make Christ known.

questions: How might God be using a current hardship in your life to show His strength to others?
Who around you might hear about Jesus through the unexpected place you are in right now?
reflections.prayer: Lord, thank You that no trial can stop the spread of Your good news. Help us to trust You when we feel weak and limited. Use our hard times to show Your strength and point the people around us to Jesus. Amen.
